inputs.name: hand over from CI/CD Pipeline to Shadow Deployment

output.level_0: The pipeline crashes before reaching shadow, leaving no deployment record for the team.
output.level_1: No handover exists, so shadow deployment never receives builds from the CI/CD pipeline.
output.level_2: An engineer manually copies artifacts from the pipeline to trigger the shadow deployment.
output.level_3: The pipeline automatically pushes approved builds to shadow deployment without human intervention.
output.level_4: Governed policies verify compliance before the pipeline triggers the shadow deployment handover.
